projects.name: II – GBS Transformation
details: TEVA GBS | August 2025 – July 2026 | Bengaluru
• Designed and delivered Lean Six Sigma capability programs, training 100+ employees across Yellow Belt and
Green Belt certifications.
• Led enterprise-wide Quality Week initiatives engaging 200+ employees, promoting operational excellence and
continuous improvement culture.
• Mentored Lean Six Sigma improvement projects GBS Finance, guiding teams through DMAIC methodology and
sustainable implementation.
• Led the Train-the-Trainer (TTT) program by coaching Yellow Belt candidates, facilitating workshops, and building
internal Continuous Improvement capability across cross-functional GBS teams.
• Led a Lean Six Sigma project that reduced LATAM bank open items by 75% through process standardization, SAP
ECC cash application optimization, and elimination of manual Excel-based remittance workflows across five
countries.
• Enhance three-way invoice matching by optimizing OCR accuracy for clean-match processing, increasing OCR
accuracy from 76% to 90%+, improving touchless invoice processing by 20 percentage points
• Led a Lean Six Sigma initiative to streamline the Record-to-Report month-end close by optimizing journal entry and
reconciliation workflows, reducing close cycle time from 8 to 5 business days, decreasing late journal entries by
• Automated operational reporting by developing Power BI dashboards, eliminating manual reporting effort by 20+
hours per week and enabling real-time operational performance monitoring.
• Managed enterprise LexComply governance by coordinating with global stakeholders to ensure regulatory
compliance and policy adherence
